item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 these are three separate sibling families inside the same Rossmann NAD(P)-binding superfamily, not one family. Alcohol dehydrogenase-like C-terminal domains are family c.2.1.1, SUNID 51736; CoA-binding domains are family c.2.1.8, SUNID 51900; and potassium-channel NAD-binding domains are family c.2.1.9, SUNID 63944. All three have the same parent superfamily c.2.1, SUNID 51735, named \"NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains\", which in turn is in fold c.2, also named \"NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains\", in class c, \"Alpha and beta proteins (a/b)\". Biologically, SCOPe is saying that these domains share the Rossmann-like NAD(P)-binding architectural and probable remote-homology context at the superfamily level, while the three named groups represent distinct families with diverged ligand usage and biological roles. One should therefore transfer only cautious, superfamily-level expectations, such as a Rossmann alpha/beta core and a nucleotide/cofactor-binding ancestry; it is not safe to annotate a potassium-channel NAD-binding domain or a CoA-binding domain as an alcohol dehydrogenase C-terminal domain, to infer alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic chemistry across the sibling families, or to assume identical substrate specificity, oligomeric context, domain boundaries, or full-protein function from a representative in another family. Templates drawn across these c.2.1 families may support a remote Rossmann-core model, but family-specific insertions and active-site or binding-site residues must be checked directly rather than copied from the alcohol-dehydrogenase, CoA-binding, or potassium-channel representative labels.","evidence_used":["list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1/children?limit=100","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/annotations","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/annotations","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/annotations","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/homology"]}]}
